title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 4.7 Solve Equations with Fractions: Determine whether a fraction is a solution of an equation
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 4.7 Solve Equations with Fractions: Determine whether a fraction is a solution of an equation
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "4.7 Solve Equations with Fractions", prints these objectives: "Determine whether a fraction is a solution of an equation" "Solve equations with fractions using the Addition, Subtraction, and Division Properties of Equality" "Solve equations using the Multiplication Property of Equality" "Translate sentences to equations and solve". The section text says: "Before you get started, take this readiness quiz. If you miss a problem, go back to the section listed and review the material." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
